name: Warm Paper
tagline: MotionCraft's warm-paper: lo-fi desk energy — warm off-white, terracotta accent, soft cards, slow and kind.

motion.direction: MotionCraft `warm-paper`, energy ≈ 0.4. Warm off-white paper, Fraunces 700 headings in sentence case, IBM Plex Mono labels, terracotta `ter` as the one accent word per sentence; cards `iv` with a warm glow and radius 22. Words rise 0.28 em from a soft blur over 12 frames; scenes blur-crossfade; camera drifts gently; hold 0.8 s + 0.25 s per word; nothing moves at once. No grain, no hard cuts, no stamps; 84 BPM calm.
